visual.name: atlynCalendarSlicer
visual.description: Free calendar slicer for Power BI. Filter a report by one concrete Date/DateTime column from a real 7-column month grid: pick a single day, drag a range, Ctrl-click individual days, or apply relative presets such as MTD, YTD and Last 7 Days.

en-US.Role_Date_Desc: One concrete Date/DateTime column to filter the report by
en-US.Role_Values_Desc: Optional measure used to heat-shade days by magnitude
en-US.Calendar_MonthsToShow_Desc: Number of months to display side by side
en-US.Calendar_ShowWeekNumbers_Desc: Show ISO-8601 week numbers in a leading column
en-US.Calendar_FiscalYearStartMonth_Desc: First month of the fiscal year; drives the QTD and YTD presets
en-US.Heatmap_Show_Desc: Colour each day by the Values measure. Note: enabling this binds a second field, which disables Power BI Sync slicers for this visual.
en-US.Landing_AddField: Add a date field to the Date bucket
en-US.Landing_NoDates: No dates are available to display
en-US.Landing_BadType: The Date field must be a concrete Date/DateTime column; date hierarchies are not supported
en-US.Data_Truncated: Only the first 30,000 dates are available; empty-day indicators are disabled because the data may be incomplete
en-US.Selection_Limit: A discrete selection is limited to 5,000 dates; the contiguous range was kept
